title: Meet Kiki, the Dartmouth sheep who drives her own wheelchair
author: Fiona Bright Holton
bullets: Local News Born with severely deformed legs, Kiki has become an internet sensation — and is inspiring new mobility solutions for disabled animals.
A sheep at a Dartmouth animal sanctuary has become an unlikely pioneer in mobility technology for disabled animals.
Kiki the sheep has made waves on the internet for videos of her zipping around the farm on a motorized cart she controls with a joystick.

title: Newton-Wellesley Hospital to close weight loss surgery center amid rise of GLP-1 drugs
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Health The hospital has seen a sharp decline in bariatric surgeries, from 219 in fiscal year 2023 to just 96 in fiscal year 2026.
Outside the Newton-Wellesley Hospital, which is closing its Center for Weight Loss Surgery.
